_meta.note: Staging output for Batch 6.5 (mk-fonts catalog). Every bundled family is OFL-1.1 (verified via records.json licenseType field, cross-checked against every face's on-disk sha256/filename -- see impl log for the verification script and its output). No font in MakhtootKit/Sources/MKFonts/Resources/Fonts/ matches _PROHIBITED.md's KFGQPC/Uthmanic entry or is flagged excluded in EXCLUDED_FONTS.md; that file documents historical D-120 candidates that were held back or released, all 45 currently-bundled families passed and are shipped on iOS today. Zero exclusions applied.
